podcast.body: The B-side to their first single, "I'm So Glad," released on Rainbow Records. While also "far from a wonderful song," it contained "the semi-collipse" and "the belights" that would later make them famous. "The B side, though, said a boom-run-dun, while it's also far from a wonderful song, does have the semi-collipse of it and the belights are made them famous."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
